chapter.title: Chapter 11
paragraphs: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times.
It was the age of wisdom, it was the age of foolishness.
It was the epoch of belief, it was the epoch of incredulity.
It was the season of Light, it was the season of Darkness.

memo.core_thesis: A Tale of Two Cities opens with the famous doubled antitheses.

comments.content: The doubling is the whole engine of the opening — every clause cancels its twin before the next can land.
'Wisdom' and 'foolishness' are not opposites here — they are the same pressure applied in opposite directions, and that collapse is the point.
